new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/agile/test_benchmark_notes.py
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+"""Tests for the optional notes field on BenchmarkRun."""
+
+from orgos.agile.benchmark import BenchmarkRun
+
+
+def test_default_notes_is_empty_list() -> None:
+    """Constructing a BenchmarkRun without notes returns notes == []."""
+    run = BenchmarkRun(name="test", duration_ms=10.0, passed=True)
+    assert run.notes == []
+
+
+def test_notes_serialise_to_json() -> None:
+    """Constructing with notes serialises through to_json()."""
+    run = BenchmarkRun(name="test", duration_ms=10.0, passed=True, notes=["a", "b"])
+    data = run.to_json()
+    assert data["notes"] == ["a", "b"]
